change: Added FOCUSA_DEPLOY_AUDIT_LOG + append-only deploy audit events (deploy_start/preflight/complete/rollback) with full GitHub context.
Added scoped safe disk cleanup that only removes rebuildable Focusa paths (target/.tmp/tmp backups/runner temp) and fails closed below min_free_gb/above max_usage_pct.
Added reproducible self-hosted runner installer with narrow sudoers rule, label set focusa-deploy,production, and version-locked GitHub Actions runner.
Capture old/new binary checksum + current_version in audit log so rollback path is auditable.
Validate systemd ExecStart references canonical install path before deploy.
Gate Deploy Live Daemon on a successful GitHub CI push run on main for the exact target commit.
Run safe-disk-cleanup preflight before deploy with min_free_gb / max_usage_pct thresholds.
Verify root + menubar version surfaces against the release tag in CI and pre-release.

root_cause: rg -q 'release:' matched only YAML key not types: [published]

guard: CI gate verify-version-surfaces.py against latest tag + spec gates compare visible version

guard: Self-hosted runner installed with focusa-deploy label
safe-disk-cleanup.sh before deploy + git pre-deploy disk threshold check
